item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00212","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C25","C21","C05"],"selected_candidate_label":"C25","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C25 is a clear, concrete drafting template for the child. Both letters describe a post–Battle Act shipment of embargoed equipment from an aid-recipient country to the Soviet bloc, explain the automatic cutoff and the President's Section 103(b) waiver authority, report the Administrator's recommendation following interagency consultation, and conclude by directing that assistance continue. The child's closing determination and quoted statutory factors are nearly verbatim from C25, with Italy, Rumania, and a grinding machine substituted for the Netherlands, Poland, and petroleum equipment. C21 and C05 share the general form of statutory foreign-assistance determinations sent to committee chairmen, but lack the distinctive Battle Act waiver machinery and language.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Any shipment of any such items listed automatically results in all military, economic and financial assistance to Italy being cut off, unless I determine... that \"cessation of aid would clearly be detrimental to the security of the United States\".","parent_excerpt":"Any shipment of any such items listed automatically results in all military, economic and financial assistance to the Netherlands being cut off, unless I determine... that \"cessation of aid would clearly be detrimental to the security of the United States.\"","explanation":"Near-verbatim statement of the automatic aid cutoff and Section 103(b) exception, adapted only to a different country."},{"child_excerpt":"The Administrator of the Act has advised me that aid to Italy should be continued. He made this recommendation after consultation with representatives of the Departments of State, Treasury, Defense, Interior, Agriculture, and Commerce...","parent_excerpt":"The Administrator of the Act has advised me that aid to the Netherlands should be continued. He made this recommendation after consultation with representatives of the Departments of State, Treasury, Defense, Interior, Agriculture, Commerce...","explanation":"The same recommendation-and-interagency-consultation sequence uses substantially identical wording and agency enumeration."},{"child_excerpt":"After studying the report of the Administrator, and in accordance with the provisions of Section 103(b) of the Battle Act, I have directed that assistance by the United States to Italy be continued.","parent_excerpt":"Therefore, in accordance with the provisions of Section 103(b) of the Mutual Defense Assistance Control Act, I have directed that assistance by the United States to the Netherlands be continued.","explanation":"The operative presidential determination is structurally and linguistically the same."},{"child_excerpt":"In reaching this determination, I have taken into account \"the contribution of such country to the mutual security of the free world, the importance of such assistance to the security of the United States, the strategic importance of imports received from countries of the Soviet bloc, and the adequacy of such country's controls over the export to the Soviet bloc of items of strategic importance.\"","parent_excerpt":"In reaching this determination, I have acted upon the advice of the Administrator... and have taken into account \"the contribution of such country to the mutual security of the free world, the importance of such assistance to the security of the United States, the strategic importance of imports received from countries of the Soviet bloc, and the adequacy of such country's controls over the export to the Soviet bloc of items of strategic importance.\"","explanation":"The child reproduces the full distinctive list of statutory considerations almost verbatim."}]}
